newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van der Moolen buys 25 pct of U.S. broker.
newsitem.headline: Van der Moolen buys 25 pct of U.S. broker.

text.p: Brokerage Van der Moolen Holding NV said on Monday it had agreed in principle to buy a 25 percent stake in U.S. stock broking specialist Surnamer, Weissman & Co LLC with an option to expand its interest to 40 percent within the next three years.
"The acquisition fits Van der Moolen's policy to strengthen its position on Wall Street," the Dutch company said in a statement.
Van der Moolen already holds a 25 percent stake in stock broking specialist LaBranche in the U.S.
It said Surnamer has 25 employees and specialises in trading in stock of about 40 companies, including those of pharmaceuticals group Pfizer.

"Van der Moolen will buy the new interest, which is expected to contribute to profits per share immediately, against payment in cash," the Dutch broker said without elaborating. It said it will get a seat on Surnamer's board. After receiving permission from the New York and Amsterdam Stock Exchanges the deal is expected to be sealed within the next two months.
